notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi fetch of the /ae/en/ (UAE English) storefront, no proxy needed - the same route the Furniture pass used. React/Material-UI SSR storefront (Landmark Group). robots.txt was fetched first and is unusually explicit: it carries an '# AI CRAWLER POLICY - All allowed' block that names 'User-agent: anthropic-ai / Allow: /', 'User-agent: Claude-Web / Allow: /' and 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Allow: /' (alongside GPTBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot, etc.). The 'User-agent: *' group is 'Allow: /' with disallows only for cart/checkout/fastpay/preBasket, my-account/login/register, INTERNAL SEARCH (/*/search*, /*?q=), and a list of tracking / price / size / manufacturer / country / language query parameters. No Crawl-delay. Every URL recorded here is a plain /ae/en/c/ category path with no disallowed parameter, and no /search URL was used (which also satisfies rule 25/27). TREE: taken from the storefront's own server-rendered mega-menu in the /ae/en/ homepage HTML (all /ae/en/c/ anchors with their nav labels; 35 distinct household-bathandlaundry nodes, 102 babyandkids nodes), then walked node-by-node: the Bath & Laundry department page /c/household-bathandlaundry (h1 'Bathroom Essentials & Accessories', 1,751 Products) lists its own nine children in order - Bath Accessories, Bath Linen, Bathroom Organizing, Waste Bins & Accessories, Laundry Solutions, Shower, Bath Mirrors, Cleaning, Weighing Scales - and each of those was opened to read its own child list. Cross-checked against /ae/en/sitemapindex.xml -> sitemap_categories.xml (656 category URLs); every URL in it matching bath|shower|toilet|sanitar|basin|sink|faucet|tap|mirror|vanity was opened individually, which is how the two sitemap-only grandchildren under Bath Linen (bathrobes / slippers) and the stray bathaccessories-accessories node were found. Rows follow the site's own ordering. QTY: every number is the storefront's own rendered listing header - the literal '<N> Products' node inside div#category-list-layout, whose markup form is '>141<!-- --> <!-- -->Products<'. No number was estimated, inferred from pagination, or carried down from a parent. VERIFICATION - four independent checks. (a) H1/BREADCRUMB: every recorded page's h1 and breadcrumb match the node requested (e.g. Toilet Brush Holders -> h1 'Toilet Brushes & Toilet Brush Holders', breadcrumb Home > Household > Bath & Laundry > Bath Accessories). (b) GRID ENUMERATION: for every category at or under one page size (48) the count of unique /p/<id> product links in the server-rendered grid equals the header EXACTLY - Accessory Sets 35, Racks & Trolleys 39, Ladders & Stools 12, Wall Fixtures & Hooks 28, Shower Fixtures & Caddies 31, Towel Holders & Stands 20, Toilet Paper Holders 22, Shower Curtain Rods 3, Bathroom Mirrors & Cabinets 14, Bath Storage 32, Weighing Scales 3, Shower Curtains 23, Kids' Towels 37, Kids' Bathrobes 9, Kids' Bath Mats 32, Brooms 31, Brushes 17. (c) CHILDREN SUM TO PARENT: Bathroom Organizing 39+12+28+31+20+22 = 152 = parent 152 exactly; Shower 23+3+59 = 85 = parent 85 exactly; Bath Linen 294+213+(55+51) = 613 = parent 613 exactly; Cleaning 31+17 = 48 = parent 48 exactly; Baby & Kids Bath 37+9+32+168 = 246 = parent 246 exactly; Bath Accessories 35+141+127+92+88+79 = 562 vs parent 563, the 1 being the orphan bathaccessories-accessories node (see EXCLUDED); and the nine department children 563+613+152+140+134+85+14+48+3 = 1,752 against the department's own 1,751, i.e. one product double-filed. (d) SECOND READ / NO DRIFT: seven categories were re-fetched later in the session with the cache bypassed (toiletpaperholders 22, racksandtrolleys 39, towelholders 20, bathmirrors 14, weighingscales 3, bathroomstorage 32, accessorysets 35) and every header was identical to the first read, with the unique-product-id count equal to the header on all seven. Counts also discriminate (3 / 12 / 14 / 20 / 22 / 28 / 31 / 32 / 35 / 39 / 59 / 79 / 88 / 92 / 127 / 141 / 168), so no site-wide constant is being echoed. PARENT-URL RULE: no parent URL was recorded where children exist - Bath & Laundry (1,751), Bath Accessories (563), Bathroom Organizing (152), Shower (85) and Bath Mirrors (14) are all grouping rows with blank qty and blank link (rules 24 and 38). Bath Mirrors is kept as a grouping row even though it has a single child, because the child /c/household-bathandlaundry-bathmirrors-bathroommirrorsandcabinets is the deepest listing URL; parent and child both show 14, so nothing is lost. MIRRORS (rule 10/11): Bath Mirrors IS recorded - its 14 products are LED and vanity mirrors (Mallory LED Vanity Mirror, Vanity Mirror with LED, Sienna LED Mirror, Avant/Daniel/Sofia Table Mirrors, Brookline 3-Tier Shelf with Mirror). Primary type is mirror, so it is Bathroom, not Lighting, even for the integrated-LED units. Its SEO h1 renders as 'Table Mirrors' but the nav label, the URL (bathmirrors-bathroommirrorsandcabinets) and the parent's h1 ('Bathroom Mirrors') all place it in Bath & Laundry. LADDERS & STOOLS (12) was kept because it is a direct child of Bathroom Organizing and over half its assortment is explicitly bathroom (Comfort Bathroom Stool, Bathroom Foldable Steps Stool, Comfort Bath Stool, Comfort Bath Foot Stool); the few general step ladders in it were not enough to move the node out of the site's Bathroom hierarchy (rule 12). BATH STORAGE (32, Furniture > Storage) was kept as Bathroom Furniture per rule 9 - h1 'Bathroom Cabinets & Bathroom Storage', assortment is Galaverna / Ladama / Breeze / Shine bathroom cabinet ranges including Undersink Storage Cabinet, Sink Cabinet with Storage, Wall Mirror with Storage and Light, and multi-piece Bathroom Cabinets sets. It does not duplicate any Bath & Laundry node (Bath & Laundry has no cabinet category at all). EXCLUDED - LAUNDRY: Bath & Laundry > Laundry Solutions (134) and its five children - Laundry Hampers, Clothes Dryer & Rails, Ironing Boards, Laundry Accessories, Laundry Cabinets - are a laundry-room department, not Bathroom; primary product type is laundry equipment (rule 2). EXCLUDED - DECOR MIRRORS: Household > Wall Decor & Mirrors > Mirrors and its Floor Mirrors / Wall Mirrors / Over The Door Mirrors children are the decorative mirror department (rule 21); Furniture > Bedroom > Dressers & Mirrors, Furniture > Living Room > Console Tables & Mirrors, Baby & Kids > Room Furniture > Dressers & Mirrors and Baby & Kids > Decor & Lighting > Mirrors are furniture/decor nodes. EXCLUDED - DUPLICATE LEGACY TREE: the sitemap also exposes a parallel kids-bathandstorage-* tree (kids-bathandstorage-bath 226, -bathroomaccessories 158, -bathmats 32, -towels 33, -bathrobesandponchos 3, -showercurtainsandaccessories 0) that the live homepage mega-menu never links to - the menu uses babyandkids-* exclusively (102 nodes, zero kids-* nodes). The first 48 products of kids-bathandstorage-bath-bathroomaccessories and babyandkids-bathandstorage-bath-bathroomaccessories are identical (48/48 name overlap), so it is the same assortment under a second URL family; only the live-nav babyandkids-* node was recorded, per rule 28. EXCLUDED - CROSS-CUTTING RE-GROUPING: Baby & Kids > Nursery > Bath Essentials (85) re-lists products already inside Baby & Kids > Bath & Storage > Bath - the same Hello Kitty Tissue Holder, Football Waste Bin, Spider-Man Toothbrush Holder, Disney Cars Soap Dispenser etc. appear in both, and it mixes towels and bath mats in with them; recording it would have double-counted. EXCLUDED - ORPHAN NODE: /c/household-bathandlaundry-bathaccessories-accessories has no nav label and holds exactly 1 product, a 'Regency Diffuser Bottle' - a home-fragrance diffuser, i.e. Decor (rule 21), not a bathroom accessory. It is the single unit of difference between Bath Accessories' 563 header and its six named children's 562. /c/household-bathandlaundry-cleaning-furnitureandkitchencleaners renders the parent Cleaning listing (h1 'Cleaning Tools', 48) rather than a distinct grid, so it was not treated as a leaf. /c/kids-bathandstorage-bath-showercurtainsandaccessories returns 0 products. NOT SOLD: Home Centre carries no sanitaryware - the 656-URL category sitemap and the full mega-menu contain no toilets, WCs, bidets, urinals, wash basins, sinks, installed bathtubs, shower enclosures, screens, shower systems/heads, bathroom taps, faucets or mixers. The only 'bathtub' node on the site is Baby > Bath & Care > Baby Bathtubs (flagged in review). There is likewise no bathroom-lighting node anywhere - Household > Lighting has Ceiling Lamps, Table & Desk Lamps, Floor Lamps, Wall Lamps, Decorative and Smart Lighting, none of them bathroom or vanity lighting - so nothing was routed to Lighting for this company. Nothing was excluded for being metal, glass, ceramic or plastic.
